# Xolvyn
> Architecture-aware code security. Xolvyn is a DevSecOps platform that scans
> any GitHub or GitLab repository for 50+ vulnerability classes and CVEs, builds
> an AST-based dependency graph, and ranks every finding by blast radius — how
> many files depend on the affected code — so engineering teams fix what is
> load-bearing first. Auto-Fix Engine opens remediation pull requests for human
> review. Private beta; launching August 2026.

## What is Xolvyn?
Xolvyn is an architecture-aware code security scanner. It maps every file,
dependency, and architecture layer in a codebase, then runs 50+ security checks
plus CVE scanning and ranks each finding by blast radius — a metric that
combines severity with how many other files depend on the affected code. A
medium-severity bug on a file that 47 others import outranks a critical bug on
an isolated file. The result is a prioritized security report (scored 0–100,
graded A–D) with one-click pull-request fixes.

## Key facts
- Ranks vulnerabilities by blast radius (severity × number of dependent files), not CVSS alone.
- AST-based dependency mapping for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Java.
- 50+ security checks + CVE scanning; OWASP/CWE-aligned; letter grade (A–D) and 0–100 score.
- Auto-Fix Engine opens remediation pull requests on GitHub/GitLab; human review required.
- PR Impact Analysis grades every pull request before merge.
- @mentor: AI assistant grounded in your real dependency graph, not generic training data.
- Privacy: shallow clone, in-memory analysis, immediate deletion; never trains on user code.
- Free for public repositories; Pro, Team, and Enterprise tiers available.
